verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a keyless JSON API for Colorado business-entity data that a script or CI job can call without a browser. It is read-only data served from the state's Socrata open-data portal rather than the registry itself, and nothing shows headless execution of the registry's core actions such as filings, renewals, or name reservations. missing for 10: headless or API-driven filing and renewal workflows, documented API or CLI from the registry itself, authentication and rate-limit docs for automation, CI usage guidance, independent corroboration beyond a single GET probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
